## Session Overview

In this session, you'll pin up a draft version of your MUP poster for review and feedback from the Planning at Illinois community. Please come prepared to both give and recieve feedback on your poster.

## Before we Meet

Print a draft version of your MUP poster. Be prepared to pin up this poster at the very beginning of our meeting time.

## After we Meet

Take the feedback you received on your draft to refine and prepare your final MUP poster for presentation at our end of the year celebration.

## Additional Resources

### Poster Printing in TBH Room 21

There are specific step-by-step instructions posted in the lab. Below are some additional general tips:

- The lab is staffed from 9am-9pm, M-TH, 9am-5pm F, and weekends from 12-5pm. Student lab staff are there to help you.

- To print posters, you will have to log onto a computer in the lab (there are 6 computers).

- Recommended Poster Size is 24 x 36

**Printer Options:**

- **Printer XL4100:** This is ideal for your dra􀅌 poster. It is cheaper to print and the paper is thinner.

- **Printer DJZ9-2:** This is a higher quality printer (matte) that may be better for your final poster. It does cost more to print.

- **Printer Z6200-2:** This is also higher quality (semi-gloss) that may be better for your final poster. Also costs more than XL4100.

Costs come directly out of your student account.

**Note:** The lab is likely to be busy, especially towards the end of the semester. To avoid having to wait in a line or risk not being able to print your poster on time, please have a plan to print early.
